text: If PaymentMethod is CHK, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount is not allowed. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK and if CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK and if CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount is optional.
reading: if PaymentMethod is CHK, no CreditTransferTransactionInformation has a CreditorAccount; otherwise one without a Creditor has a CreditorAccount
